#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Edits the file in place using python-pptx (no OOXML unpacking required).
"""
import os
import sys

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

PATH = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"

if not os.path.exists(PATH):
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: {PATH} not found in working directory {os.getcwd()}")

prs = Presentation(PATH)
n_before = len(prs.slides)

# Use the last slide's layout so the closing slide matches the deck's design.
layout = prs.slides[-1].slide_layout
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)

# Prefer the layout's title placeholder (inherits themed styling/color).
title_ph = next((ph for ph in slide.placeholders if ph.placeholder_format.idx == 0), None)
if title_ph is not None:
    title_ph.text = TEXT
else:
    sw, sh = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(
        Emu(int(sw * 0.10)), Emu(int(sh * 0.70)), Emu(int(sw * 0.80)), Emu(int(sh * 0.16))
    )
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = TEXT
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.size = Pt(34)

prs.save(PATH)

# Verify the result by reopening the file.
prs2 = Presentation(PATH)
slides2 = list(prs2.slides)
assert len(slides2) == n_before + 1, f"expected {n_before + 1} slides, got {len(slides2)}"
last_texts = [sh.text_frame.text for sh in slides2[-1].shapes if sh.has_text_frame]
assert any(TEXT in t for t in last_texts), f"final slide missing text: {last_texts!r}"
print(f"OK: {PATH} now has {len(slides2)} slides; final slide contains {TEXT!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Pure-stdlib OOXML edit: reads the package in memory, adds a new slide part
(reusing the last slide's layout), wires it into [Content_Types].xml,
ppt/presentation.xml, and ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels, then rewrites the
package in place. A backup of the original is kept next to the file.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

PATH = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"
BACKUP = "Q4_financial_report.original.pptx"

if not os.path.exists(PATH):
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: {PATH} not found in working directory {os.getcwd()}")

shutil.copy2(PATH, BACKUP)

with zipfile.ZipFile(PATH, "r") as z:
    entries = {i.filename: z.read(i.filename) for i in z.infolist()}
    names = set(entries)

# ---------------- parse presentation.xml ----------------
pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")

m = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*?\bcx="(\d+)"[^>]*?\bcy="(\d+)"', pres_xml)
cx, cy = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (12192000, 6858000)

sld_ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*?\bid="(\d+)"', pres_xml)]
r_embeds = re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*?\br:id="(rId\d+)"', pres_xml)
if not r_embeds:
    sys.exit("ERROR: could not find slide references in presentation.xml")

# ---------------- locate the last slide part ----------------
rels_xml = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode("utf-8")
rel_map = dict(
    re.findall(r'<Relationship[^>]*?\bId="(rId\d+)"[^>]*?\bTarget="([^"]+)"', rels_xml)
)
last_slide_path = rel_map.get(r_embeds[-1])
if not last_slide_path:
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: no target found for {r_embeds[-1]} in presentation rels")
last_num = int(re.search(r"slide(\d+)\.xml$", last_slide_path).group(1))

# ---------------- new slide number ----------------
existing_nums = [
    int(re.search(r"slide(\d+)\.xml$", n).group(1))
    for n in names
    if re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide\d+\.xml$", n)
]
new_num = max(existing_nums) + 1
new_slide = f"ppt/slides/slide{new_num}.xml"
new_slide_rels = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{new_num}.xml.rels"

# ---------------- reuse the last slide's layout ----------------
layout_target = "../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"
last_rels_name = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{last_num}.xml.rels"
if last_rels_name in entries:
    last_rels = entries[last_rels_name].decode("utf-8")
    lm = re.search(
        r'<Relationship[^>]*?\bType="[^"]*?/slideLayout"[^>]*?\bTarget="([^"]+)"',
        last_rels,
    )
    if lm:
        layout_target = lm.group(1)

# ---------------- new ids ----------------
new_r_id = "rId%d" % (max(int(r[3:]) for r in re.findall(r"rId(\d+)", rels_xml)) + 1)
new_sld_id = str(max(sld_ids) + 1) if sld_ids else "256"

# ---------------- new slide XML (centered card with the thank-you text) ----------------
slide_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/><a:chOff x="0" y="0"/><a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/></a:xfrm></p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYou"/><p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm><a:off x="{int(cx * 0.10)}" y="{int(cy * 0.70)}"/><a:ext cx="{int(cx * 0.80)}" cy="{int(cy * 0.18)}"/></a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>
          <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="FFFFFF"><a:alpha val="92000"/></a:srgbClr></a:solidFill>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr"><a:spAutoFit/></a:bodyPr>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p><a:pPr algn="ctr"/><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="3600" b="1"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="1F3864"/></a:solidFill></a:rPr><a:t>{TEXT}</a:t></a:r></a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>'''

slide_rels_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout" Target="{layout_target}"/>
</Relationships>'''

# ---------------- wire the new slide into the package ----------------
ct = entries["[Content_Types].xml"].decode("utf-8")
if f'PartName="/{new_slide}"' not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace(
        "</Types>",
        f'<Override PartName="/{new_slide}" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/></Types>',
    )
entries["[Content_Types].xml"] = ct.encode("utf-8")

if f'r:id="{new_r_id}"' not in pres_xml:
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace(
            "</p:sldIdLst>",
            f'<p:sldId id="{new_sld_id}" r:id="{new_r_id}"/></p:sldIdLst>',
        )
    elif "<p:sldIdLst/>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace(
            "<p:sldIdLst/>",
            f'<p:sldIdLst><p:sldId id="{new_sld_id}" r:id="{new_r_id}"/></p:sldIdLst>',
        )
    else:
        sys.exit("ERROR: cannot locate p:sldIdLst in presentation.xml")
entries["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres_xml.encode("utf-8")

rels_xml_new = rels_xml.replace(
    "</Relationships>",
    f'<Relationship Id="{new_r_id}" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide{new_num}.xml"/></Relationships>',
)
entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = rels_xml_new.encode("utf-8")

entries[new_slide] = slide_xml.encode("utf-8")
entries[new_slide_rels] = slide_rels_xml.encode("utf-8")

# ---------------- rewrite the package ----------------
tmp = PATH + ".tmp"
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name in names:
        z.writestr(name, entries[name])
    for name in (new_slide, new_slide_rels):
        if name not in names:
            z.writestr(name, entries[name])
os.replace(tmp, PATH)

# ---------------- verify ----------------
with zipfile.ZipFile(PATH, "r") as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None, "zip integrity check failed"
    new_names = set(z.namelist())
    assert new_slide in new_names and new_slide_rels in new_names, "new slide parts missing"
    assert all(n in new_names for n in names), "original parts missing after rewrite"
    pres2 = z.read("ppt/presentation.xml").decode("utf-8")
    assert f'r:id="{new_r_id}"' in pres2, "slide reference missing from presentation.xml"
    assert new_slide in z.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    assert TEXT in z.read(new_slide).decode("utf-8"), "thank-you text missing from new slide"

print(
    f"OK: {PATH} now has {len(r_embeds) + 1} slides; "
    f"added {new_slide} with {TEXT!r} (original backed up at {BACKUP})"
)
